Class FormatContext

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.format.FormatContext
public class FormatContext extends Object
The FormatContext type holds the settings for one format pass. The type stores the column width, the table style, and the optional SGR sequences. SGR is the select-graphic-rendition sequence that sets terminal color. The type does not refer to SSH or to Spring. SSH is the secure-shell protocol, and Spring is the application framework. The column width starts at 80. The table style starts at ascii. Each SGR string starts empty.
